# v0.3.39 — Main chat reads as one conversation; misrouted messages fix themselves

## What's changed

- **Main chat hides topic switches by default.** Where each message went stays visible in the topic workspace; the one-line notice can be turned back on in Settings.
- **TheOne no longer asks where a message belongs.** When the classifier cannot tell which of a few topics you mean, the closest one does the work and the others come along as reference; with nothing to go on it stays in the current topic or starts a new one. The questions while history is being catalogued, after a large-catalog review, when history search fails (the classifier now sees the whole catalog) and from rule-based routing are gone. Only a missing model and an unclear "wrong topic" still ask.
- **A topic hands back a message that is not its own.** Before doing anything, the topic that received a message can give it back; TheOne routes it again without that topic and main chat shows the right topic's answer. The first topic's turn is kept out of its history and memory. Once per message.
- **Answers draw on memory from any topic the message refers to.** When a message mentions a number, code or name that only another topic has mentioned, the topic doing the work is given what that topic said about it and where it stands, linked or not (private and unlinked topics stay out). When the second look moves a message to another topic, the first comes along as reference. Topics can also search every topic that shares with them.
- **Switching between topics no longer links them.** Only a message that draws on several topics, or a topic looking another one up, teaches that two topics are related.
- **Large routing requests are cut down instead of failing.** With many topics whose summaries were filled by compaction, a request could pass the size limit and fall back to rules (staying in the current topic) without anyone noticing.
- Smaller fixes: opening another topic just after a message went elsewhere now teaches that topic the message's terms (it never took effect before); the router pauses only briefly after a rate limit, and failures made together count once; terms work in every script (accented Latin, Cyrillic, Korean, Japanese); "New topic: …" works in English; the classifier writes titles and reasons in the message's language.

Validation: type checks and the full automated suite (312 tests, including the hand-back and memory recall) pass on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2, and the plugin archive builds. These changes have **not yet been measured with a real model** on InterleaveBench; that run (routing regression, how often topics hand back wrongly, and whether recalled memory improves answers) comes next. Not yet used by hand in a running DSH.

## 中文

- **主聊天默认不显示话题切换**：每条消息去了哪个话题，在话题工作区里看；想要那行提示可以在设置里打开。
- **不再问你消息该放哪里**：分不清是哪几件里的哪一件时，交给最接近的那件，其余作为参考带上；什么线索都没有时，留在当前话题或新建一个。历史还在整理、话题太多搜不到、历史检索失败（现在改为直接看全部话题）、规则判断拿不准时的追问都去掉了。只有没配置模型、或者你说「分错了」却没说去哪时还会问。
- **话题发现不是自己的事会交回**：收到消息的话题在动手之前可以把消息交回，TheOne 去掉这个话题重新分配，主聊天显示的是正确话题的回答；原话题的那一轮不会进它的历史和记忆。每条消息最多交回一次。
- **回答能用上任意话题的记忆**：消息里的数字、编号、名字如果只在别的话题出现过，干活的话题会拿到那个话题说过的原话和它的现状，不管两者有没有关联（不共享、已断开关联的话题除外）。「再判断一次」改了结论时，第一次选的话题也作为参考带上。话题检索历史时也能搜所有允许共享的话题。
- **来回切换不再算相关**：只有一句话同时用到两件事、或者一个话题去查了另一个，才学成相关。
- **路由请求太大时会压缩而不是失败**：话题多、摘要被压缩填满时，请求可能超长，悄悄改用规则（留在当前话题）。
- 小修：分错后紧接着点开另一个话题，现在真的会学到这条消息的词（以前从不生效）；限流后只短暂暂停，同时失败的请求只算一次；分词支持所有文字（带重音的拉丁字母、俄文、韩文、日文）；英文「New topic: …」可用；模型写的标题和理由跟随用户的语言。

验证：在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 上类型检查和全部自动化测试（312 项，含交回和按线索取记忆）通过，插件包构建正常。这些改动**还没有用真实模型在 InterleaveBench 上测过**，接下来会跑：路由有没有变差、话题会不会误交回、带上的记忆能不能让回答更准。还没有在运行中的 DSH 里手动使用过。
